source_caption:
📺 Young Sheldon (2017–2024)

Young Sheldon follows Sheldon Cooper, a brilliant young genius growing up in East Texas during the late 1980s and early 1990s. With an extraordinary intelligence far beyond his age, Sheldon struggles to fit in at school and understand the everyday behavior of those around him. His protective mother Mary encourages his academic ambitions, while his father George, twin sister Missy, older brother Georgie, and outspoken grandmother Meemaw bring humor and heart to his unusual upbringing. From awkward classroom situations to unforgettable family moments, Sheldon discovers that being exceptionally intelligent doesn’t make growing up any easier. Serving as a prequel to The Big Bang Theory, Young Sheldon combines hilarious comedy with heartfelt storytelling about childhood, family, friendship, and finding your place in the world.

🎭 Genre: Comedy • Family • Drama • Sitcom

⭐ IMDb: 7.7/10

⏱️ Runtime: Approximately 22 minutes per episode • TV-PG

🎥 Creators: Chuck Lorre & Steven Molaro

📺 Where to Watch: Netflix and HBO Max in the United States. Availability varies by region.

source_details.synopsis: Young Sheldon is an American sitcom television series created by Chuck Lorre and Steven Molaro which aired on CBS from September 25, 2017, to May 16, 2024. The series is a spin-off prequel to The Big Bang Theory that takes place during the late 1980s and early-to-mid-1990s, and follows child prodigy Sheldon Cooper as he grows up with his family in East Texas. Iain Armitage stars as Sheldon, alongside Zoe Perry, Lance Barber, Montana Jordan, Raegan Revord, and Annie Potts. Jim Parsons, who portrayed the adult Sheldon Cooper on The Big Bang Theory, narrated the series and served as an executive producer.
